blurb: Guests take a scenic helicopter flightseeing tour over glaciers and mountains before landing at a glacier dog sledding camp. They meet Alaskan Husky sled dog teams and professional mushers, then ride on a dog sled with opportunities to drive the sled and take photos. The experience occurs in summer at 3500' elevation on the glacier.
extraNote: Bags and additional items not allowed on helicopter; personal items must be carried on person; secure storage at heliport · Reservations recommended early due to limited availability and quick filling · Heliport for helicopter flight
